Statistics

0x23
Sync/Async
Asynchronous

TrcvIdx
Index of the Ethernet transceiver within the context of the
Ethernet Transceiver Driver
Parameters (inout)
None

MacSecStatsPtr

participant
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: The request has been accepted E_NOT_OK: The request
has not been accepted
Description
Request the Ethernet Transceiver Driver to provide MACsec statistics.
